explication: Atlas is a database schema-as-code product with declarative and versioned migration workflows. The graph follows CLI requests through those workflows to schema planning, linting, and database operations, and includes the shared SQL and HCL layers plus documented testing, security, and cloud capabilities. The README documents features whose implementation is not sampled; their paths use existing enclosing directories, and uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
